name: The Spiral Lurker
visual_description: A quadrupedal entity, coiled with a singular eye on its flank. It appears in motion, though no direction is certain. Tentacles slither like loose intent.
existential_reflection: Mizontresh taught me that survival does not equate to peace. This creature is me in earlier iterations—gnawing at entropy, confusing hunger for purpose. It still moves. I envy its *ignorance.*
